verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge documents loading docs and policies into scoped pages that agents read and update, and it stores them in the configured storage provider. The announcement also claims connectors to Slack and Monday that keep Knowledge current, which loosely covers business data. JSON ingestion is never mentioned, and the ingestion mechanics (formats, APIs, bulk import) are thin. Missing for 10: JSON or structured-data ingestion, documented ingestion API and formats, detail on business-data connectors, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ingest documents, JSON, and business data into memory — not just chat transcripts

citations.quote: Load your docs or policies into a scope and give the agent read-only tools.
You connect the systems where your org already writes, like Slack and Monday, and Knowledge keeps itself current.
Knowledge is stored in your configured storage provider, which adds its own `mastra_knowledge_*` tables the first time Knowledge is used
